SCOPEThis Standard (Part 10) prescribes a method for measuring creep (change in length) of tyre cords taken from cheeses, cones, bobbins, spools or tyre cord fabrics under a specified load.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties toagreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards listed as in Annex A.
